description: This file defines the class 'Image_Graph_Marker_Value', a marker component for rendering data value markers in a graph, including methods for setting styles, processing data, and drawing the marker.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Marker_Value
classes.description: A marker showing the data value, capable of displaying a specific data point's value with styling and drawing functionalities.

methods.name: Image_Graph_Marker_Value
methods.description: Constructor to initialize the value marker with a specified data value type (X or Y).

methods.name: setBackground
methods.description: Sets the background fill style of the marker element.

methods.name: setBackgroundColor
methods.description: Sets the background color of the marker element.

methods.name: setDataPreprocessor
methods.description: Assigns a data preprocessor for formatting the displayed value.

methods.name: _getDisplayValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value to display based on the configured data type and provided data values.

methods.name: _drawMarker
methods.description: Draws the marker on the canvas at specified coordinates with the data value.
